about.intro: Hello! I'm Syed Mohammed Faham, a passionate AI/ML Developer dedicated to creating intelligent and innovative machine learning solutions.
about.expertise: With expertise in artificial intelligence, machine learning algorithms, and data science, I specialize in building intelligent systems, predictive models, and AI-powered applications that solve complex real-world problems.
about.interests: I enjoy continuous learning and staying updated with industry trends, particularly in Generative AI. Outside of work, I love reading technology blogs, acquiring new skills, engaging in strategic video games and Coffee.

experience.description: Built an end-to-end housing code violation detection pipeline using GoPro footage, GPS telemetry, and Gemini vision models with automatic parcel resolution against NYS Erie County public data and dynamic frame extraction.
Built and deployed full-stack web applications including a virtual try-on system and a React frontend for user interaction.
Designed responsive web interface and worked closely with clients to meet their needs.

testimonials.name: Rauhan Ahmed
testimonials.text: Faham is an incredibly talented Full Stack Developer who I had the pleasure of working with at Tech Consulting Partners. He's a quick learner who effortlessly adapts to new technologies. Whether it's ReactJS, NextJS, and NodeJS, or any Backend Management, Faham always delivered exceptional results. We worked together on several full stack AI applications, and I was consistently impressed by his ability to handle both frontend and backend development with ease. His deep understanding of complex systems and his positive attitude made him a joy to work with. Faham is not only a skilled developer but also a great teammate — I highly recommend him for any full stack development role.
